description: Every pinned version in this repo stays current, one PR a week. Nothing merges itself and nobody is tagged.

Not tracked, on purpose: Zig in .github/scripts/setup-zig.sh (ziglang.org tarballs with a sha256 per OS, which no Renovate datasource can update together; the README and build.zig.zon name the same version, so a bump is done by hand in one commit).
Not tracked, on purpose: the Artifact Signing client nupkg in build.yml, whose SHA256 Renovate's NuGet datasource cannot update alongside the version.

packageRules.description: One grouped PR for everything that isn't a major version.
Majors come one per PR, since they may need code changes.

customManagers.description: Tools CI downloads from GitHub releases: a `tag=` line, then the URL, then its sha256.
